title: Questions to reflect on
reflectErrorBody: Your answers are still here. Give it another try in a moment.

loopCheck.stuckLoop: The thing you keep coming back to - is it telling you something new, or are you arriving at the same conclusion each time?
loopCheck.friendView: What would you say to a close friend in this exact situation?
loopCheck.setAside: What would change if you set this thought aside for five minutes?

drill.opening: Which time in your life would you like to talk about? Start with a scene you remember.
drill.placeholder: Write as much or as little as you like
drill.closing: Would you like to save what you have shared so far?
drill.dayLimit: This conversation stops here. The daily usage limit has been reached. Save what you have shared so far and pick it up again later.
drill.loopNote: Let me change direction for a moment.
drill.failed: Could not fetch the next question. Please try again.
drill.emptyAnswer: A few words are enough. You can also skip or stop here.
drill.saveBody: Your conversation is saved as it is. No result is estimated yet. As records build up, they affect star brightness.
drill.scaffoldNote: Not knowing is fine. You can describe a fact you remember or skip this.
drill.intro: Share only what you want to. You can skip or stop at any time.
drill.anotherScene: Is there another moment you would like to talk about instead?
drill.concreteQuestion: What is one thing you remember doing in that moment?
drill.openerHint: Tap to start writing, then edit it
